searchText: MSRP $268,470. New 2027 Entegra Condor 23S All-Wheel Drive (AWD) Luxury B+ RV. Features Customer Value Package Full Body Paint Cab TV Outdoor Kitchen Rear Awning More About This RV The Condor features one-piece seamless fiberglass front cap, van compass front and rear lift, 12V lithium battery, 2KW inverter, backup camera, aqua-view showermiser, internal holding tanks, 2 twin-size beds that convert to a king-size bed, stainless steel sink, induction cooktop, convection microwave, Firefly multiplex system, High-Intensity LED ceiling lights, 4-way swivel driver and passenger seats, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping system, rain-sensing wiper system, dual-pane acrylic windows and E-Z drive which includes a computer-balanced driveshaft, heavy-duty rear stabilizer bar, hellwig helper springs and rubber body isolation body mounts. New for 2027 includes graphics, dovetail drawer boxes, AC onto Inverter and Sideview cameras (23S only).
